changes: Added a main-level DONE merge lock shared by story_advance DONE and done_recover; added partial-DONE detector, doctor reporting, recovery command, safety checks for clean main/story worktree/merge-tree, process-fact registration, lifecycle docs, and smoke regressions including the F-006 branch-local DONE guard.
usage: Use normal story_advance --storyId=<id> --phase=DONE. If a partial-DONE is reported, run koala doctor to inspect it, then koala done_recover --storyId=<id> after main and the story worktree are clean.
expectedOutcome: Concurrent DONE operations serialize before main-affecting mutation; live lock contention leaves the story pre-DONE; partial-DONE stories are detected and recoverable without handwritten git commands.
actualTranscript: test:worktree-authority-smoke passed; test:worktree-repair-smoke passed; koala validate passed with 17/18 covered and 0 required missing; transcript-diff.md records expected versus actual operator-visible behavior.
outcomeDiff: No required gap. Actual behavior matches expected; only a should-level reviewer meta-check remains intentionally uncovered.
limitations: Does not solve merge conflicts automatically and does not recover dirty story worktrees; done_recover refuses unsafe states and requires the operator to clean or resolve them first.
pitfalls: F-006 showed recovery eligibility must be proven from the story branch metadata, not main metadata. checklist_update can overwrite evidence, so batch evidence was used to avoid losing coverage. koala doctor still shows unrelated health-log and Codex adapter warnings in this worktree.
